ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERLOCATION_SEC
AS
BEGIN
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1-- AND LINKCODE = 'P'
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
,
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
AS(
	SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSC.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
    ,'HOME' AS LocationTypeId
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(HOME_ADDR1, HOME_ADDR2, HOME_ADDR3, HOME_ZIP, HOME_COUNTRY)),1) AS LocationId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE

UNION

SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSC.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
    ,'OFFICE' AS LocationTypeId
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(OFC_ADDR1, OFC_ADDR2, OFC_ADDR3, OFC_ZIP, OFC_COUNTRY)),1) AS LocationId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE

UNION

SELECT 
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,BSC.CLTCODE) AS CustomerId
    ,'PERMANENT' AS LocationTypeId
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(PERM_ADDR1, PERM_ADDR2, PERM_ADDR3, PERM_ZIP, PERM_COUNTRY)),1) AS LocationId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE

)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, PeriodEndTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL AND SourceCode = 'SEC'		
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;


-----------------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL;
 
---------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerLocation  ( 
 CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,GlobalLocationNumber
,PreferenceId
,CustomerLocationNote
,HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason
,ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.LocationTypeId AS LocationTypeId
,SRC.LocationId AS LocationId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS CustomerLocationNote
,NULL AS HoldMailIndicator
,NULL AS HoldMailInitiatedById
,NULL AS HoldMailReason
,NULL AS ResidenceTypeId
,NULL AS PeriodOfResidence
,SRC.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC   
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerLocation  ( 
 CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,GlobalLocationNumber
,PreferenceId
,CustomerLocationNote
,HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason
,ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,LocationTypeId AS LocationTypeId
,LocationId AS LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS CustomerLocationNote
,NULL AS HoldMailIndicator
,NULL AS HoldMailInitiatedById
,NULL AS HoldMailReason
,NULL AS ResidenceTypeId
,NULL AS PeriodOfResidence
,SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;


END
